inputs.description: Artifact type: VIP + lvlibp builds, or single-arch VIP only
Target LabVIEW bitness for dev-mode tasks

tasks.label: Build release asset (VI Package x64)
args: & { $repo = "${workspaceFolder}"; $getVer = Join-Path $repo 'scripts/get-package-lv-version.ps1'; $ciGate = Join-Path $repo 'scripts/check-ci-gate.ps1'; $build = Join-Path $repo 'scripts/run-build-or-package.ps1'; $analyze = Join-Path $repo '.github/actions/analyze-vi-package/run-local.ps1'; $vipDir = Join-Path $repo 'builds/VI Package'; $minLv = & $getVer -RepositoryPath $repo; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not $minLv) { exit 1 }; & $ciGate -WorkflowFile '.github/workflows/ci.yml' -RepositoryPath $repo; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Host 'CI gate failed. Ensure gh is installed/authenticated and a successful .github/workflows/ci.yml run exists for this commit. Set GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN if needed.'; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & $build -BuildMode 'vip+lvlibp' -WorkspacePath $repo -LabVIEWMinorRevision 3 -LvlibpBitness '64'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & $analyze -VipArtifactPath $vipDir -MinLabVIEW $minLv }

tasks.label: Draft release
args: & { $runId = & "${workspaceFolder}/scripts/check-ci-gate.ps1" -WorkflowFile ".github/workflows/ci.yml" -RepositoryPath "${workspaceFolder}" -Quiet -ReturnRunId; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not $runId) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; gh workflow run draft-release.yml -f run_id=$runId }
